chunks: It is narrated that when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was taken, Bilāl refrained from the adhan and said, “I will not give the adhan for anyone after the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.” And indeed, Fāṭimah عليها السلام said one day, “I long to hear the voice of my father’s caller to prayer in the adhan.”

When that reached Bilāl, he began the adhan. When he said, “Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar,” she remembered her father عليهما السلام and his days, and she could not restrain herself from weeping. Then when he reached his saying, “I bear witness that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah,” Fāṭimah عليها السلام gave a cry, fell upon her face, and lost consciousness.

So the people said to Bilāl, “Stop, O Bilāl, for the daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله has departed from this world.” They thought that she had died, so he cut off his adhan and did not complete it.

Then Fāṭimah عليها السلام regained consciousness and asked him to complete the adhan, but he did not do so. He said to her, “O mistress of women, I fear for you because of what you may bring upon yourself when you hear my voice in the adhan.” So she excused him from that.

key_terms.أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّه: the testimony in the adhan affirming the Messengerhood of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْبُكَاءِ: weeping arising from grief and remembrance
key_terms.بِلالٌ: Bilāl, the mu’adhdhin mentioned in the report
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ: Lady Fāṭimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What happened when Bilāl gave the adhan for Fāṭimah عليها السلام after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله passed away?
ai.summary: This report recounts Bilāl’s refusal to call the adhan after the passing of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, out of loyalty and grief. It also depicts the deep sorrow of Fāṭimah عليها السلام when hearing the adhan associated with her father, showing her intense love and remembrance of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.
